description: This file defines the DefaultCircuitBreakerConfig class, which implements the MongoDbConfig.CircuitBreakerConfig interface. It provides configuration settings for circuit breaker behavior, including maximum failure count and timeout configurations, and includes methods for creating instances from configuration objects, equality checks, and string representation.

classes.name: DefaultCircuitBreakerConfig
classes.description: Implements CircuitBreakerConfig with settings for max failures and timeout configuration.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a DefaultCircuitBreakerConfig instance from a given Config object.

methods.name: getMaxFailures
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of failures before tripping the circuit breaker.

methods.name: getTimeoutConfig
methods.description: Returns the TimeoutConfig associated with this circuit breaker configuration.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if another object is equal to this DefaultCircuitBreakerConfig instance.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes the hash code for this config instance.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of this config instance.
